name: Cash Award (MBOCWWB)
benefit:
1. Every year, the Board awards a cash prize to three male and three female children of registered construction workers in each district who achieve the highest marks in the SSLC examination.
   1. The award amounts are ₹1000/-, ₹750/-, and ₹500/- respectively.
_eligibility_text:
1. The beneficiary should be a resident of Meghalaya.
   1. The beneficiary should be engaged in any building or other construction work.
   1. The beneficiary should be registered under the Meghalaya Building &amp; Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
   1. The beneficiary should have an active membership of the Board.
   1. Registered construction workers whose child or children achieve the highest marks in the SSLC examination within their district can apply to avail the benefits of the scheme.
